contract.priceText: INR 8,21,00,400/- (Eight Crore Twenty One Lakhs Four Hundred Only) plus GST as applicable, subject to measurement of actual quantities executed and certified

stages.milestone: Day 0 — Project mobilisation. No mobilisation advance is payable

Day 20 — Execution: partition line marking, frameworks, single-side skinning, civil wall, plastering, plumbing, ceiling and wall electrical conduiting, floor raceway laying; material delivery of gypsum frames/sheets, conduits, siporex blocks; key order closures HVAC, fire alarm, carpentry

Day 40 — Execution: closing of partitions from double side, electrical wiring, fire sprinkler piping, FAS wiring; material delivery duct material, wires/cables, ply; key order closures modular furniture, chairs, carpets, glass

Day 55 — Execution: painting base-coat prep, glass channel, HVAC duct installation, false ceiling framing; material delivery carpets, sanitary fittings, doors, DB/MCB; key order closures decorative elements, glass films, wallpapers, canvas frames, branding

Day 70 — Execution: electrical switches/sockets, sanitary fixtures, carpentry structures ready, flush doors, first coat of paint, false ceiling, before HVAC final commissioning, before LV commissioning; material delivery modular furniture on site, carpet on site; key order closures deep cleaning
Day 75 — released against submission of unconditional bank guarantee for 12 months DLP, subject to virtual completion / handover and submission of required close-out documents
stages.trigger: 5% released against submission of unconditional bank guarantee for 12 months DLP, subject to virtual completion / handover and close-out documents

contradictions.what: The tracker has a job to confirm RA1 was raised and collected
contradictions.against: the contract says RA1 is 0% and no mobilisation advance is payable
contradictions.detail: owned by Atish / Finance, due 2026-07-03, status Not started
contradictions.why: one of the two is wrong and the difference is whether anybody should be chasing a bill

why: the RA schedule is the contract's own: six stages at fixed days from commencement, 0/20/25/25/25/5 per cent. A stage falling due is not an entitlement — it is claimable when its work is done, and the two are shown apart. Raised, certified and collected are three different things and nothing here collapses them. None of the three is recorded anywhere on this project, so they start empty and a person fills them
